Measurement Methodology for QoS Parameters under Regulation 4.- Access Service (Wireline) 3.1. Service Provisioning 3.1.1. Provision of a service within 7 working days of payment of demand note by the customer (i) Access Service (wireline) must be provisioned by the service provider within 7 working days of the payment of the demand note by the prospective subscriber. As far as possible, the service providers should issue the demand note after ascertaining the technical feasibility to avoid delay in provisioning and inconvenience to prospective subscribers.
